prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training day with 4000+ calorie intake and carbohydrate loading for endurance

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals 4000+ calories across all meals and snacks
Carbohydrates comprise 60-65% of total calories with strategic timing around training
Includes hydration recommendations at key intervals throughout the day
Plan is presented in compact, single-day format with clear meal timing
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring 4000+ calories with emphasis on carbohydrate loading and hydration timing throughout the day

prompt_inputs.goal: Maximize strength and muscle gain for weightlifting competition in 8 weeks

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes 4-5 meals with protein distributed evenly (minimum 30g per meal)
Pre-workout and post-workout nutrition strategically timed around training session
All meals are lactose-free and practical to prepare
Total daily calories and macros support strength/muscle gain goals for 85kg athlete
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) needing precise protein distribution across meals and strategic pre/post-workout nutrition around training sessions

prompt_inputs.goal: Maintain current weight while optimizing performance and recovery for competitive gymnastics

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals 1,800-2,000 calories distributed across 4-5 meals
Includes minimum 90g protein from vegetarian sources to support muscle recovery
Contains iron-rich and calcium-rich foods to address vegetarian micronutrient needs
All meals are nut-free and practical to consume on a competition day
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport requiring weight management (jockey or gymnast) where the meal plan must be calorie-controlled while maintaining performance nutrition and micronutrient density
